editorial:
Imagine a wild night out that changes your life forever. That is exactly what happens to Ben, a laid-back slacker, and Alison, a rising TV reporter, after a drunken one-night stand. When Alison discovers she is pregnant, these two very different people are forced to figure out if they can actually build a life together. The movie mixes big laughs with real heart, showing how messy and funny love and parenthood can be when you are totally unprepared.

The cast is fantastic, especially Seth Rogen and Katherine Heigl, who make you care about this odd couple. The jokes land often, and the side characters add extra laughs. On the downside, some scenes run a bit long and a few jokes feel dated. Still, if you enjoy romantic comedies with real emotion, this one is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ben finally steps up and proves he is ready to be a father. During Alison's labor, he stays by her side and supports her through the birth. After their baby is born, the two share a tender moment that shows they are committed to making it work as a family. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Ben and Alison together, ready to face parenthood as a team despite their differences.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with real emotion.
